roleCases.title: service_role still resolves a consumer person
roleCases.expectation: the insert succeeds and returns an id
roleCases.observed: insert returned a well-formed person id

roleCases.title: service_role resolution is idempotent
roleCases.expectation: a duplicate is refused by the unique index and the same row resolves
roleCases.observed: duplicate=ERROR:  duplicate key value violates unique constraint "rcap_persons_partner_match_key_idx" | resolved=same row

roleCases.title: one auth user cannot resolve another user's consumer person
roleCases.expectation: user A's derived key never selects user B's row
roleCases.observed: A-key rows other than A's own=0, B-key matching A's row=0

roleCases.title: a browser role cannot squat the reserved consumer namespace
roleCases.expectation: the insert into the reserved namespace is refused
roleCases.observed: ERROR:  permission denied for table rcap_persons

roleCases.title: a real partner slug cannot collide with the reserved namespace
roleCases.expectation: both INSERT and UPDATE of partner_records to the reserved slug are refused
roleCases.observed: insert=ERROR:  partner_records: expungement-ai-consumer is the reserved direct-to-consumer person namespace and cannot be registered as a partner slug | update=ERROR:  partner_records: expungement-ai-consumer is the reserved direct-to-consumer person namespace and cannot be registered as a partner slug

tenantCases.title: partner-admin queries cannot read consumer-person rows
tenantCases.observed: ERROR:  permission denied for table rcap_persons

tenantCases.title: partner-admin queries cannot mutate consumer-person rows
tenantCases.observed: ERROR:  permission denied for table rcap_persons

tenantCases.title: consumer-person rows do not enter partner participant counts
tenantCases.expectation: the partner's distinct-people count counts only its own person

tenantCases.title: consumer-person rows do not alter partner packet reporting
tenantCases.expectation: no packet attributed to the partner resolves to a consumer person

tenantCases.title: consumer-person rows do not enter partner entitlement lookup
tenantCases.expectation: no entitlement resolves through the reserved namespace

tenantCases.title: consumer-person rows do not enter packet-cap consumption
tenantCases.expectation: no consuming ledger event is keyed to a consumer person
tenantCases.observed: consuming ledger rows for consumer people = 0

tenantCases.title: consumer-person rows do not enter sponsored attribution
tenantCases.expectation: a job cannot carry both a partner and a consumer binding
tenantCases.observed: ERROR:  packet_render_jobs: a sponsored job must not carry consumer binding fields

tenantCases.title: a DTC consumer cannot receive sponsored packet context
tenantCases.expectation: no job holds a partner and a consumer identity at once

tenantCases.title: browser-supplied identity cannot control canonical identity
tenantCases.expectation: the reserved namespace admits only digest keys, and no partner namespace admits one
tenantCases.observed: email-in-reserved=ERROR:  new row for relation "rcap_persons" violates check constraint "rcap_persons_reserved_namespace_shape" | consumer-in-partner=ERROR:  new row for relation "rcap_persons" violates check constraint "rcap_persons_reserved_namespace_shape"

tenantCases.title: existing sponsored person resolution remains unchanged
tenantCases.expectation: a partner person still inserts and still dedupes on (partner_slug, match_key)
tenantCases.observed: insert=ok dedupe=ERROR:  duplicate key value violates unique constraint "rcap_persons_partner_match_key_idx"

tenantCases.title: matter id is stable for one Briefcase item
tenantCases.expectation: the same item yields the same matter

tenantCases.title: distinct Briefcase items produce distinct matter ids
tenantCases.expectation: different items never share a matter

tenantCases.title: the reserved namespace constant agrees with the database function
tenantCases.expectation: the module constant equals the migration's namespace

mutations.title: RLS disabled alone does not reopen the table
mutations.expectation: the other defence still denies every participant row
mutations.observed: before=protected, after: error= permission denied for table rcap_pers

mutations.title: a re-granted authenticated SELECT alone does not reopen the table
mutations.expectation: the other defence still denies every participant row

mutations.title: removing RLS and the revoke together turns the audit red
mutations.expectation: protected before; participant rows readable after

mutations.title: removing the reserved-slug guard turns the audit red
mutations.observed: before= partner_records: expungement-ai-consumer is the rese | after=accepted

mutations.title: dropping the partner filter from reporting turns the audit red
mutations.expectation: the scoped count excludes the consumer person; the unscoped count includes it

mutations.title: letting the reserved namespace become a partner turns the audit red
mutations.expectation: no entitlement resolves through the namespace while the guard stands; one does once it falls
